policy.title: Privacy Policy
policy.subtitle: Personal Data Protection Framework v{version}
policy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Construction OS collects, how it is processed, and the rights you can exercise over it. It applies to the mobile app, the web app, and the platform services behind them.

collection.title: Data Collection
collection.body: We collect only the personal data needed to run construction operations and to meet safety and legal obligations:

items.identity: Identity — your full name, and your employee code on workforce records.
items.contact: Contact — your phone number and email address, used for sign-in and notifications.
items.location: Location — GPS coordinates attached to check-in/check-out, daily site reports, issues, safety incidents and inspections. Coordinates are optional on every one of those records. Check-in coordinates are kept for 90 days and then reduced to a daily count; coordinates on the other records are kept for as long as the record itself.
items.photos: Site photos — images attached to site reports and inspections. Faces may appear; no facial recognition is performed.
items.financial: Payroll — your agreed daily rate on a project. No bank account details are stored.

collection.note: We do not collect biometric identifiers such as fingerprints or face scans, and we run no facial recognition on any image. Site photos may incidentally show a person's face; those images are protected by the same project access controls as the record they belong to. We also do not collect national ID numbers or dates of birth. The retention period for each data type is defined in our data retention policy.

usage.title: Data Usage
usage.body: Your data is used to operate your projects, to record safety and quality compliance, and to produce the reports your organisation relies on.
usage.quote: Analytics run on aggregated figures and pseudonymous identifiers, and personal data is removed before any text is sent to an AI model.
usage.processors: Processing takes place on our platform and with a limited set of service providers under data processing agreements: cloud infrastructure and storage, identity, edge protection, workflow, and the AI report service.
usage.residency: Data is stored in your organisation's assigned home region — Thailand (ap-southeast-7) for Thai organisations, Ireland (eu-west-1) for EU organisations, and Singapore (ap-southeast-1) otherwise — with Singapore acting as the disaster-recovery region for Thai data. One exception: sign-in codes are delivered through an SMS gateway in Singapore, so your phone number reaches that gateway when you sign in.

compliance.title: PDPA & GDPR
compliance.body: Under the Thai Personal Data Protection Act and the GDPR you may exercise the following rights:

rights.access: Right to access — obtain a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
rights.portability: Right to portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format.
rights.erasure: Right to erasure — have your identity data removed. Records subject to a legal retention period are anonymised rather than deleted.
rights.restrict: Right to restrict processing — have processing of your data suspended.

compliance.deadline: We respond to a verified request within 30 days.

security.title: Technical Security
security.body: Personal data is protected by the following controls:

controls.atRest: AES-256 encryption at rest, with keys held in cloud hardware security modules
controls.tls: TLS 1.3 minimum on all public endpoints
controls.mesh: Zero-trust service mesh with mutual TLS

security.trustCenter: Full control status, certificate references and our sub-processor list are published on our Trust Center.

rights.title: User Rights
rights.body: Change which notifications you receive in notification settings. Access, portability, erasure and restriction requests go to our DPO.
rights.contact: Withdrawing consent for safety-related data collection may limit access to areas of a site where that data is required.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.intro: These are the categories of information the platform records while work is carried out on a site.

identity.title: Identity
identity.body: Your full name and your employee code on workforce records, used to confirm who carried out a piece of work.

location.title: Location & GPS
location.body: GPS points optionally attached to check-in, daily reports, issues, incidents and inspections. Check-in points are kept 90 days.

technicalLogs.title: Technical logs
technicalLogs.body: Request traces, errors and performance figures, used to keep the platform running and to investigate faults.

aiOcr.title: AI & OCR extraction
aiOcr.body: Photographed documents are read on our servers to pull out figures. Personal data is removed before any text reaches a model.

geofencing.title: Site geofencing
geofencing.body: Boundary alerts around a site perimeter. Not built: no geofence exists anywhere in the platform, and none is collected from you.

iot.title: IoT & machine sensors
iot.body: Environment and machinery telemetry from connected site equipment. The pipeline is specified but is not running at this stage.

onDeviceAi.title: On-device AI
onDeviceAi.body: Running extraction on the handset rather than our servers. Today every model runs server-side; nothing is inferred on your device.

dataCollection.footnote: We do not collect biometric identifiers, national ID numbers or dates of birth, and we run no facial recognition on any image. The retention period for each category is set in our data retention policy.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.intro: What the information above is used for, and what it is not used for.

safety.title: Safety & security
safety.body: Incident records, permit checks and sign-in evidence, so everyone on site is accounted for and hazards stay traceable.

efficiency.title: Operational efficiency
efficiency.body: Scheduling, material movements and progress tracking, so delays and cost overruns are visible while they can still be acted on.

compliance.title: Compliance & legal
compliance.body: Audit records and retained evidence, produced when a regulator, client or insurer needs proof of how work was carried out.

aiTraining.title: AI model training
aiTraining.body: Training forecasting and risk models on operational data. Nothing is trained today: each model has a data threshold this stage has not met.

dataUsage.footnote: Analytics run on aggregated figures and pseudonymous identifiers, and personal data is removed before any text is sent to an AI model.

pdpaGdpr.title: PDPA & GDPR
pdpaGdpr.intro: This platform is built to the Thai Personal Data Protection Act and the EU General Data Protection Regulation.

sovereignty.title: Sovereignty
sovereignty.body: You keep control of your own data, including the right to see it, correct it and have it erased.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.body: Data is encrypted both at rest and in transit, so it cannot be read by anyone who is not authorised to.

purpose.title: Purpose limitation
purpose.body: Processing is confined to the purposes named in this notice. A new purpose needs a new lawful basis.

thaiPdpa.title: Thai PDPA
thaiPdpa.body: Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 — the framework this notice is written against for Thai organisations.

euGdpr.title: EU GDPR
euGdpr.body: General Data Protection Regulation — applied whenever an EU resident's personal data is processed.

region.title: ap-southeast-7 (Bangkok)
region.body: Thai organisations' data is held in Bangkok, with Singapore as the recovery region. EU organisations are held in Ireland.

iso27001.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
iso27001.body: Information security management certification. Targeted six months before the Stage 2 to Stage 3 transition; not yet held.

soc2.title: SOC 2 Type II
soc2.body: Security, availability and confidentiality audit. Targeted six months before the Stage 1 to Stage 2 transition; not yet held.

pdpaGdpr.footnote: Certification status is reported here rather than claimed. Where a certificate is not yet held, the row says so.

technicalSecurity.title: Technical Security
technicalSecurity.intro: The controls that protect personal data on this platform, described in general terms.

encryption.title: Data encryption
encryption.body: AES-256 on stored data, with keys held in cloud hardware security modules and field-level encryption for secrets.

networkGuard.title: Network guard
networkGuard.body: A web application firewall in front of the platform, with the origin restricted so traffic cannot bypass it.

tenantIsolation.title: Tenant isolation
tenantIsolation.body: PostgreSQL row-level security separates each organisation's records at the database, not only in application code.

region.title: Primary region
region.body: Production runs in ap-southeast-7 (Bangkok), with ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) held as the disaster-recovery region.

liveStatus.title: Live status page
liveStatus.body: A public health feed for these services. Not published yet — this screen states the architecture, not a real-time reading.

technicalSecurity.footnote: Certification status is on the PDPA & GDPR screen. This is a general description of the controls, not an audit report.

userRights.title: User Rights
userRights.intro: Transparency and control over your own data, under PDPA and GDPR.

access.title: Right to access
access.body: Ask for a copy of the personal data held about you, and for confirmation of how it is being processed.

rectification.title: Right to rectification
rectification.body: Ask for inaccurate personal data to be corrected, or for an incomplete record to be completed.

portability.title: Right to data portability
portability.body: Receive your data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format that another system can read.

erasure.title: Right to erasure
erasure.body: Ask for your data to be removed. Records under a legal retention period are anonymised in place rather than deleted.

userRights.footnote: Sign in to exercise these rights from your account, or send a request to our Data Protection Office from the Privacy Policy screen.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Please review the following legal requirements for operating within the Construction OS industrial ecosystem.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using the Construction OS platform, including all field-service modules, real-time safety tracking, and automated reporting systems, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by these Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy.

license.title: Industrial Usage License
license.body: Construction OS grants you a non-exclusive, non-transferable, limited license to access and use the software solely for professional construction project management and site supervision. Use for benchmarking or competitive analysis is strictly prohibited.

responsibilities.title: User Responsibilities
responsibilities.body: Users must maintain active PPE compliance as logged within the Safety Module. Failure to report site incidents or intentional bypassing of the AI Safety Guardian will result in immediate platform restriction. You are responsible for ensuring all field data entered is accurate and representative of actual site conditions.

ownership.title: Data Ownership & IP
ownership.body: Project-specific data remains the property of the contracting entity. However, Construction OS retains ownership of the underlying algorithms, interface designs, and aggregated, anonymized industrial performance metrics used for system optimization.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: Construction OS is a management tool and does not replace professional structural engineering or legal safety oversight. Construction OS is not liable for structural failures, site accidents, or financial losses resulting from incorrect data interpretation or sensor failure in extreme environmental conditions.

termination.title: Termination of Access
termination.body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access without notice if security protocols are breached or if payment for enterprise-tier services remains outstanding for more than 30 business days.

login.title: I can't log in
login.answer: Check the number or email you are signing in with, and that the device has a connection — the status above says whether the platform is reachable. After five failed attempts the account locks for 15 minutes. If it stays locked, your supervisor or tenant admin can reset it for you.

photos.title: Photos aren't syncing
photos.answer: Photos are held on the device and upload by themselves once you are back in range; the sync indicator in the top bar shows how many items are still waiting. The queue holds 100 photos and warns you at 80 — past that, get back in range before shooting more.

gps.title: GPS is inaccurate
gps.answer: Move into the open, away from heavy machinery and steel structures, and turn on high-accuracy location in the device settings. Coordinates are optional on every record, so a poor fix never blocks you from saving one.

permit.title: Safety permit issues
permit.answer: A permit needs current certification on file. Check your own record for anything expired, and raise it with the safety officer on site — they can clear the work while the paperwork is corrected.

assistant.online: The device is connected and the platform answered the last check. If something still fails, the topics above cover what field crews hit most.

portal.exportBody: Ask for a copy of everything this platform holds about you, in a file you can keep or move elsewhere.

preferences.title: Contact preferences
preferences.body: Choose which notifications reach you, and by which channel.

network.title: Network origin
network.body: What your connection’s address tells us, and the one behavioural label derived from it.

device.title: This device
device.body: How this handset is identified, how much it is trusted, and why.

security.title: Account security
security.body: Every device signed in to your account, and how this one unlocks.

session.title: Session details
session.body: How long you stay signed in, and how that is protected.

timestamps.title: Timestamps
timestamps.body: How the time of every record is captured and how long it is kept.

identity.title: Identity & contact
identity.lede: These are the values stored on your account right now, read from your own record. Only you and administrators in your organisation can see them.
identity.accessBody: Role-based: administrators in your organisation and the project managers you are assigned to. Every administrative read is audit-logged.

purposeAuth.title: Signing in
purposeAuth.body: Your phone number receives the sign-in code; your email is the alternative sign-in route.

purposeSafety.title: Safety notifications
purposeSafety.body: Reaching you quickly when a safety incident affects a site you work on.

purposeAudit.title: Audit record
purposeAudit.body: Attributing each action to a person, which safety and accounting rules require.

identity.actionExport: Request a copy of my data
identity.offline: Showing what is cached on this device — connect to load your current record.

location.title: Site & location
location.lede: Coordinates are attached to field records, not tracked continuously. Your device is not followed between records, and location is optional on every one of them.
location.whereBody: Five record types can carry one: check-in/out, site reports, issues, incidents and inspections. No coordinate means none was captured.

attendance.title: Check-in and check-out
attendance.body: Confirms attendance at a site. Reduced to a daily count after 90 days.

reports.title: Daily site reports
reports.body: Places a report on the site it describes.

issues.title: Issues
issues.body: Locates a defect so it can be found again.

incidents.title: Safety incidents
incidents.body: Locates a hazard for the safety response.

inspections.title: Inspections
inspections.body: Records where an inspection was carried out.

capture.title: Captured on your device
capture.caption: Only at the moment you save a record

geocode.title: Turned into an address
geocode.caption: By our own server — coordinates are not sent to any mapping company

store.title: Stored with the record
store.caption: Encrypted at rest, isolated per organisation

optional.title: Always optional
optional.body: A record saves normally without a coordinate.

noTracking.title: No continuous tracking
noTracking.body: Nothing is recorded between the moments you save a record.

purge.title: 90-day reduction
purge.body: Check-in coordinates become a daily count after 90 days.

geofence.title: Site geofencing
geofence.body: Automatic site-boundary detection is specified but not implemented.

logs.title: Technical logs
logs.lede: Every action that changes data is recorded so it can be attributed later. This is an accountability record, not analytics — it is never used to profile you.
logs.retentionBody: Application logs: 30 days live, then a year archived. Audit entries: seven years, write-once, as safety and accounting rules require.

actor.title: Who
actor.body: The account that performed the action.

action.title: What and when
action.body: The action, the record it touched, and a timestamp in UTC.

ip.title: Network address
ip.body: The IP address the request came from.

device.title: Device
device.body: The browser or app build that made the request.

app.title: The app
app.caption: The entry is written as the action completes

gateway.title: API gateway
gateway.caption: Authenticates and rate-limits before anything reaches the platform

store.title: Log store
store.caption: Indexed for search, retained on the schedule above

archive.title: Archive
archive.caption: Audit entries copied to storage that cannot be rewritten

redaction.title: Automatic redaction
redaction.body: Stripping personal data from logs automatically is not implemented; today it depends on engineering practice.

manual.title: What you enter
manual.lede: Most of what the platform knows is what your team types in. These are the forms that create records, and what each one is used for.

reports.title: Daily site reports
reports.body: Progress, weather, manpower counts and blockers for a working day.

incidents.title: Safety incidents
incidents.body: Hazards and accidents, routed immediately to the safety officer and project manager.

inspections.title: Inspections
inspections.body: Checklist results, including failures that open an issue.

issues.title: Issues
issues.body: Defects and rework raised against a task or location.

materials.title: Material consumption
materials.body: What was used on a task, recorded against the project.

attribution.title: Attributed to you
attribution.body: Each submission is stored with your account and the time it was saved.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: Entries are queued on your device and sent when you reconnect; nothing is lost.

immutable.title: Corrections, not deletions
immutable.body: A submitted record is corrected by a later entry — the original stays in the audit trail.

iot.title: Equipment sensors
iot.lede: None of this is running today. Sensor telemetry is specified for a later phase, and no device data is being collected from you or your equipment now.
iot.noteBody: Listed so the picture is complete: if equipment telemetry is switched on, you will read about it here first, with its own retention period.

location.title: Machinery location
location.body: Position of heavy equipment on a site.

health.title: Equipment health
health.body: Engine hours, fuel use and load, read from the machine.

environment.title: Site conditions
environment.body: Noise, dust and temperature measured on site.

ai.title: Automated processing
ai.lede: Where the platform uses automated analysis, and what it is given. No automated decision is taken about you as a person, and nothing here decides pay, discipline or employment.

ocr.title: Reading documents
ocr.body: Extracting line items from invoices and delivery notes you photograph.

summary.title: Report summaries
summary.body: Drafting a summary of site reports for a manager to review.

ppe.title: Safety equipment detection
ppe.body: Checking photos for helmets and vests.

progress.title: Progress from photos
progress.body: Comparing site photos against the design model.

strip.title: Personal data removed first
strip.body: Text is stripped of personal data before it is sent to a language model.

advisory.title: Advisory only
advisory.body: Generated output is a draft for a person to accept or reject, never an automatic action.

confidence.title: Confidence is shown
confidence.body: Low-confidence output is withheld rather than presented as fact.

delete.title: Erasing your data
delete.lede: What we can and cannot erase, and what happens to the rest. Please read this before making a request — parts of it are fixed by law, not by preference.
delete.howBody: Send the request to our Data Protection Office — the address is in the Privacy Policy. We answer within 30 days. No self-service button yet.

identity.title: Your identity and contact details
identity.body: Erased or replaced with an anonymous placeholder.

location.title: Location history
location.body: Erased. Check-in coordinates older than 90 days are already reduced to a count.

reports.title: Site reports and inspections
reports.body: Kept — accounting and safety law require them — but your name is replaced so they no longer identify you.

audit.title: Audit entries
audit.body: Kept for their full retention period. They exist to prove who did what and cannot be rewritten.

delete.whyBody: Erasure cannot override a duty in law to keep a record. Where one must be kept, its personal parts are removed so it stops identifying you.

session.title: Session details
session.lede: How this app keeps you signed in, and for how long. Every value below is what the platform actually does — read from the specification it is implemented against, not from a description of it.

offlineQueue.title: Working offline
offlineQueue.body: When the signal drops, what you write is queued on this device and sent when you are back online. Nothing is lost between the two.

rolePermissions.title: What your role may do
rolePermissions.body: Every request is checked against the permissions granted to your role. The list is fixed in the platform specification, not set per person.

tokenRotation.title: Renewing your session
tokenRotation.body: Your sign-in renews in the background so you are not interrupted. Each renewal replaces the previous credential rather than extending it.

param.accessTokenNote: How long a single credential is valid before it is renewed.
param.refreshTokenNote: How long you can stay signed in without entering a code again. Renewing replaces the credential; it is never reused.
param.transportNote: Every request between this app and the platform is encrypted in transit.
param.tokenIdNote: The identifier of the credential this device is using right now, shortened. It changes every time your session is renewed.

timestamps.title: Timestamps
timestamps.lede: Every record this platform keeps carries the moment it happened. These are the four things that are true about how those moments are recorded.

utc.title: One clock, everywhere
utc.body: Times are stored in UTC in a standard format, so a record made on one site and read on another cannot disagree about when it happened.

precision.title: Down to the microsecond
precision.body: Timestamps are stored finer than the events they order, so two actions a fraction of a second apart stay in the order they happened.

appendOnly.title: Audit entries cannot be deleted
appendOnly.body: The app cannot delete rows from the audit log. The database enforces this, not application code, so it holds even if the app is wrong.

retention.title: How long they are kept
retention.body: Application logs: {hot} days live, then {cold} year in cold storage. Audit entries: {worm} years in write-once storage.

network.title: Network origin
network.lede: What your network address tells this platform. Everything on this screen is worked out when you open it and then discarded — none of it is stored.
network.unavailableBody: The panel could not be read just now. Rather than guessing, nothing is shown — pull back and try again.
network.origin: Where your connection appears to come from
network.placeNote: City level only, looked up on our own servers. Your address is never sent to another company for this.
network.ispNote: The network operator your connection belongs to.
network.noOriginBody: This installation has no location database, so your address is not resolved to a place at all. The lookup simply is not running here.
network.connectionNote: Read from this handset, not guessed from your address.
network.latencyNote: How long this screen’s own request took. Measured here, not estimated.
network.behaviourOffBody: You have not agreed to operational profiling, so no behavioural label is worked out for you. This is not the same as having too little data.

contextBody.STATIONARY: Your last {points} check-ins were all within {radius} m of the same point.
contextBody.MOBILE: Your check-ins over the last {days} days spread up to {metres} m apart, which is wider than a single site.
contextBody.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Fewer than {min} check-ins with a location in the last {days} days. Not enough to say anything, so nothing is said.

network.ruleBody: Stationary: all located check-ins in the last {days} days within {radius} m of their centre, at least {min}. Fewer is never stationary.
network.retentionBody: Your address is stored with each audit entry: logs 30 days then a year archived, audit entries 7 years. Place and provider are not stored.

reattest.title: Device re-verification
reattest.refreshedBody: This device proved it still holds its security key. Its trusted period has been extended and the check has been written to your audit log.
reattest.unavailableBody: This device could not produce its security key just now. Nothing is wrong with your account — no proof was made, and nothing changed.

deviceDetails.title: Device details
deviceDetails.lede: What this platform knows about the device you are holding, and how much it currently trusts it.
deviceDetails.notEnrolledBody: It has not been registered for trusted sign-in yet. It will register itself the next time you sign in with a code.

scorer.AI_VERIFIED: Worked out by a trained model

deviceDetails.capped: One finding is holding this score down

cappedBy.FAILED: The platform reported that this device did not pass its integrity check. That alone limits the score, however long the device has been in use.
cappedBy.COMPROMISE_ON_RECORD: A device on your account was reported compromised. That limits the score for every device on the account until it is resolved.

band.PASSED_NO_TIER: App attested on genuine Apple hardware
band.UNDER_7_DAYS: Registered less than a week ago
band.COMPROMISE_ON_RECORD: A device on your account was reported compromised

deviceDetails.installIdNote: Created by this app and kept in secure storage. It is not a hardware serial number — reinstalling the app produces a new one.
deviceDetails.bindingNote: A key held in this device’s secure hardware, which cannot be copied off it. It signs silently at sign-in and is separate from app unlock, which you can turn on under Account Security.

integrityNote.PASSED: Google or Apple confirmed this device’s integrity when it registered.
integrityNote.FAILED: The platform answered, and this device did not pass. This usually means it is rooted, modified, or not a physical device.
integrityNote.UNAVAILABLE: We asked and could not be told — for example, no Play services on this device. This is not a finding against your device.
integrityNote.NOT_ATTEMPTED: This device registered before the check existed. It has not failed anything; it was simply never asked.

deviceDetails.tierNote: Shown instead of a security patch date. Neither Google nor Apple reports a patch date to an app, and on recent Android a Strong result already means the device was updated within the last year.

accountSecurity.title: Account security
accountSecurity.lede: The devices signed in to your account, and how this one unlocks.
accountSecurity.noDevicesBody: No device is registered for trusted sign-in yet. The one you are using will register itself the next time you sign in with a code.
accountSecurity.revokeSelfWarning: This is the device you are using. Removing it means your next sign-in here will need a code again.
accountSecurity.biometricNote: Ask for your face or fingerprint when the app is reopened. This is separate from signing in, and it does not leave this device.
accountSecurity.biometricUnavailable: Biometric unlock was not turned on
accountSecurity.biometricUnavailableBody: Your device declined, or no face or fingerprint is set up on it. The switch stays off rather than showing a lock that would never appear.

dataExport.title: Get a copy of your data
dataExport.lede: You can ask for a copy of the personal data this platform holds about you. Choose what to include, confirm it is you, and the archive is prepared for you to download.

identity.title: Identity
identity.body: Your name, and the account details that identify you.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Your phone number and email address.

location.title: Location
location.body: Coordinates attached to your check-ins, reports and inspections.

financial.title: Financial
financial.body: Your recorded hours and the pay rates agreed with you.

operational.title: Activity
operational.body: What you did and when, including the network address each request came from.

formatHint.JSON: One structured file that keeps the original data types. Best if you plan to move it to another system.
formatHint.CSV: One spreadsheet file per table. Best if you plan to open it yourself.

dataExport.verification: You will be asked to confirm it is you
dataExport.verificationBody: A code goes to your registered phone or email before the archive is built. It holds everything about you, so confirming is worth it.
dataExport.stepUpFailed: The confirmation code could not be sent. Please try again.

codeSent.SMS: We sent a 6-digit code to your phone ending {hint}. Enter it below to confirm this request.
codeSent.EMAIL: We sent a 6-digit code to {hint}. Enter it below to confirm this request.

dataExport.codeRejected: That code was not accepted. Check it and try again.

QUEUED.title: Request received
QUEUED.body: Your request is waiting to be picked up. You can leave this screen — it will keep going without you.

PREPARING.title: Preparing your archive
PREPARING.body: Your data is being gathered from across the platform. This can take a while for a long history.

READY.title: Your archive is ready
READY.body: Download it below. The link is created fresh each time you tap, so nothing shareable is left lying around.

FAILED.title: It did not finish
FAILED.body: Your archive could not be built. Nothing about your data has changed, and you can ask again.

EXPIRED.title: This archive has expired
EXPIRED.body: The download period has passed and the file has been deleted. You can request a new copy at any time.

dataExport.expiresIn: Available to download for {n} more days
dataExport.linkFailed: The download link could not be opened. Please try again.
dataExport.notAvailableYet: Not available yet. Requesting a copy of your data is not switched on for this organisation yet — nothing has gone wrong, and you can ask our Data Protection Office in the meantime.
